text:
Lina Park: Auditor asked for a compact evidence package for 2025-03-07 UTC (24h). They want: RBAC change list, KMS usage traces (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey), key metadata (rotation status), and 3 end-to-end sample traces tying PR -> role change -> service account -> KMS requestId. No raw customer data.
Diego Morales: Sounds good. Scope: Okta/SCIM provisioning deltas, k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding events, CloudTrail KMS events, and PR refs for each change. We'll hash principals.
Riya Shah: Agreed. I'll export rolebinding changes and SCIM diffs filtered by org_id. Plan to output rbac_changes.csv with columns: change_id, principal_hash, action, resource, pr_ref, approver, utc_iso_ts.
AuditorBot: Please ensure each row has a linkable PR or ticket ID. Hashed principals are fine; auditor needs chain-of-custody.
Tom Becker: On KMS: export CloudTrail events where eventName in ("Decrypt","GenerateDataKey") and keyId in scope. Fields: utc_time, eventName, keyId, requester_principal_hashed, requestId, encryptedDataKey_base64, responseElements. Also include DescribeKey and GetKeyRotationStatus snapshots.
Lina Park: Redaction policy? We'll replace emails/usernames with `user_sha256:<hex>` and service accounts with `sa_sha256:<hex>`. Document the hash algorithm (sha256) in README. Keep requestIds and timestamps intact.
Diego Morales: Example Splunk query (adapt as needed):
```
index=audit OR index=cloudtrail
("RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding" OR eventName="Decrypt" OR eventName="GenerateDataKey" OR source="scim")
| where _time>=strptime("2025-03-07T00:00:00Z","%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") AND _time<strptime("2025-03-08T00:00:00Z","%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
| table _time,eventName,eventType,principal,resource,requestId,requestParameters,responseElements
```
Riya Shah: After export I'll canonicalize timestamps to ISO8601 and run the hashing script. I'll also build change_mapping.csv: change_id, pr_ref, approver, deployed_at_utc, notes.
Tom Becker: For key snapshots include KeyMetadata JSON (no key material), key policy versions and rotation flag. Auditor asked to confirm whether any rotation occurred in-window; if none, include GetKeyRotationStatus output showing false.
AuditorBot: Also request 3 representative end-to-end traces. Minimal: PR# -> rbac_changes.csv change_id -> k8s event -> kms CloudTrail event requestId. Hashing allowed.
Lina Park: We'll select 3 traces that are unrelated to customer data and redact any other sensitive fields.
Diego Morales: Packaging: zip named `redwood_audit_2025-03-07.zip` with files: rbac_changes.csv, kms_events.ndjson (newline JSON), key_snapshots.json, change_mapping.csv, sample_traces.txt, MANIFEST.txt, README.md, MANIFEST.txt.asc (GPG sig). MANIFEST.txt will list sha256 for each file.
Tom Becker: I'll sign the manifest with GPG key `sec-audit@redwood` and include fingerprint in README. Include verification steps in README.
Riya Shah: Vulnerability linkage: small vuln_map.csv (vuln_id, service, fix_pr, fixed_at_utc, severity). No stack traces or PII. If a vuln fix touched an affected service during window, include the mapping; otherwise leave empty.
AuditorBot: Reminder: if any entries reference customer PII, auditor requires LOA. Hashed IDs are acceptable without LOA.
Lina Park: Timeline: auditor requested delivery by EOD Monday. Can we do that?
Diego Morales: I can run the exports tonight and drop raw files into a secure S3 bucket.
Riya Shah: I'll process, hash, and assemble the package tomorrow morning.
Tom Becker: I'll pull key metadata and do the GPG signing after review. Expect signed manifest by mid-day.
Lina Park: Also offer a 20-minute walkthrough to show the Splunk query and a sample trace live. Auditor prefers live verification for at least one sample. Are folks available Friday 11:00-11:20am PT?
Riya Shah: I can do 11:00.
Tom Becker: Works for me.
Diego Morales: I'll join.
AuditorBot: Please attach MANIFEST sha256 and presigned S3 link to the calendar invite once available.
Lina Park: Will do. Once upload completes I'll post the presigned link and manifest sha256 in this thread. Remember: do not include raw emails in any uploaded files. If auditor requests unredacted logs, require LOA.
Diego Morales: Noted. Also adding internal checklist: spot-check 10 random RBAC rows for correct hashing, verify 3 sample traces tie correctly, and verify manifest signature.
Riya Shah: Starting exports now. I'll ping when raw exports are in the secure bucket.
Lina Park: Thanks team. Update here when uploads and signature are ready. :thumbsup:
